style: Bright, soft 3D cartoon animation for children, warm autumn colours, simple clean background, gentle camera movement, no text, no letters, no words on screen, no speech, only soft natural sound effects.

words.scene: A cute cartoon fox walks slowly through an autumn forest; dry orange and yellow leaves in a low bush shiver and swish softly as a breeze passes, a few leaves lifting and settling.
A cartoon girl at a desk finishes a tall pile of homework, drops her shoulders, closes her eyes and lets out one long relieved breath, then smiles.
Tall cartoon trees and long grass on a hill sway gently from side to side in the wind, while a child on a rope swing beneath them sways along.
A nervous cartoon squirrel wobbles on the very tip of a thin, bending twig high up in a tree, arms out for balance, the twig dipping under its weight.

A cartoon boy seen from behind, standing on a sandy beach facing the sea, his back to the camera. He raises one hand to shade his eyes and looks straight ahead at a tiny white sailboat on the faraway horizon, the sailboat directly in front of him in the centre of the picture. The camera slowly pulls back and rises to show how far away the sailboat is across the wide blue sea. The boy never turns around.
A cartoon girl kneels in a garden holding a magnifying glass, carefully watching a red ladybug crawl along a green leaf, eyes wide with curiosity.
Two cartoon autumn leaves hang side by side on a branch; a gust of wind pulls them apart and they float away in opposite directions.
A single glowing golden leaf floats down into a child's open hands; soft warm light spreads and the child smiles peacefully, as if the leaf stands for hope and peace.
